clues.text: This planned place sits in the high lands of the middle west of its vast country. It stands far inland, far from the busy sea coast.
clues.narrowing: Rules out coastal places; keeps a planned place in high lands in the middle west, far inland.

source.quote: Located in the Brazilian Highlands in the country's Central-West region

clues.text: The year here splits into two clear seasons, one rainy and one dry. In the dry season, the air can hold almost no damp at all.
clues.narrowing: Rules out lands with rain all year; keeps two clear seasons and a very dry season.

source.quote: with two distinct seasons: the rainy season , from October to April, and the dry season , from May to September

clues.text: For a long time the capital sat in Rio de Janeiro, far to the south east. In 1956 a president kept his pledge and set out to build a fresh capital inland.
clues.narrowing: Shrinks the list to the fresh inland capital set in motion by a president in 1956.

source.quote: Upon taking office in January 1956, in fulfilment of his campaign pledge, he initiated the planning and construction of the new capital

clues.text: Workers built this whole capital from bare ground and opened it in 1960. From the air, its wide main road and curved wings look like a plane.
clues.narrowing: Nearly decisive: a whole capital built from bare ground, opened in 1960, shaped like a plane.

source.quote: it was founded by President Juscelino Kubitschek on 21 April 1960, to replace Rio de Janeiro as the national capital

clues.text: All three branches of the government of Brazil are based in this place. A square named for the three powers holds their main buildings side by side.
clues.narrowing: Confirms it: all three branches of government sit here around one square.

source.quote: All three branches of Brazil's federal government are located in the city: executive, legislative and judiciary

reveal.blurb: Brazil kept its capital in Rio de Janeiro for nearly 200 years, but its leaders wanted a seat near the centre of the land. President Kubitschek had a whole fresh city built on the high plains, and it opened in 1960. Brasília is the capital of Brazil.
